quest.title: The Emergence of Irate Fish?
quest.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Miss Guillotin mentioned you've been running an aquarium. Naturally, I accepted her invitation to come serve as a marine consultant!

choices.text: Happy to have you on board!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! With Head Nurse Sigewinne around, we won't have to worry about the little fishies getting sick!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hehe, since you asked me to look after the animals at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, I've picked up a few tricks of the trade...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: It turns out looking after animals isn't all that different from caring for patients. Well, the well-behaved ones, at least.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: But that's the thing — not all fish are well-behaved. So, on top of looking after the ones you already have, I have a few ideas for inpatient therapy that I'd like to discuss.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please, go ahead. I'm all ears.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: The word from Officer Ceasth is that certain wild fish have been getting unusually aggressive lately. Apparently, they're attacking other creatures, as well as divers and even small boats.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: I was wondering if we could invite them to the aquarium for some rest and relaxation? At the very least, it'll keep them from causing any more trouble.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Once they're here, I can look for a way to cure their sudden bad temper.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: That way, we can help the fish and the waters return to normal, and you can add some unique guest performers to your aquarium.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Alright, I'll give you all the intel I have on where to find those aggressive fish. The rest is up to you!

choices.text: We're so glad for the extra help!
